data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: state_file_conflict): cycle_ledger.py must expose a single _resolve_artifacts_dir() function mirroring shell semantics from get_artifacts_dir() in hooks/lib/deps.sh: (a) default path /tmp/workflow-plugin-<16-char-hash-of-REPO_ROOT>/; (b) WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env var override; (c) one-time legacy-path migration from /tmp/lockpick-test-artifacts-<worktree-name>/ when new path is empty. Add parity test: set WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR, write via shell, read via Python (assert same file); unset, drop a legacy file, assert Python migrates it once.
